verdict.overall: Since Sunday the biggest mover is TSLA, up 6.4% to 395.92, but the nearest expiries flipped to OPPOSING with a ceiling sitting right at 400, so confidence that the rally keeps running is fading rather than rising. AMAT, AVGO, SPY and QQQ look steadiest for range-based swings with little change in their setups. ZETA, PLTR and APP look weakest, combining upcoming earnings with increasingly pricey options, which raises the odds of a sharp move rather than a calm range.

tickers.TSLA: Since Sunday: weaker for continuing higher - price jumped 6.4% to 395.92 but the 10-30 and 11-13 expiries flipped from NEUTRAL to OPPOSING, and every date now shows a ceiling right at 400, meaning resistance has hardened just above price.
tickers.AVGO: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 2.8% to 330.83 but all four expiries stay NEUTRAL, with floors and ceilings only inching up (floor 320-330, ceiling rising to 365-380 by 11-20), a fairly calm range-trading setup.
tickers.META: Since Sunday: little changed - price slipped slightly to 640.54, all expiries remain NEUTRAL, with magnets and ceilings drifting a touch lower. Trend is down and momentum weak, so upside looks capped near 680-700.
tickers.AMD: Since Sunday: a bit weaker tone - ceilings rose to 540-600 and the 11-20 floor jumped from 440 to 500, showing more defensive positioning even as price gained 2.9% to 531.73. Earnings on 11-03 add extra risk within this window.
tickers.MU: Since Sunday: weaker for the 11-20 expiry, which flipped from NEUTRAL to OPPOSING, with its floor rising from 750 to 850 and ceiling climbing to 1050, even though price is up 4.1% to 913.44. Earlier dates stay calm and NEUTRAL.
tickers.PLTR: Since Sunday: little changed - price edged up 1.3% to 199.25, with 11-13 and 11-20 still OPPOSING. Options get pricey from 11-06 onward, and earnings land 11-02, adding risk right as positioning turns more cautious.
tickers.NVDA: Since Sunday: little changed overall - price rose 2.6% to 216.36, scores hold NEUTRAL except 11-20's OPPOSING. The 11-06 floor dropped from 200 to 185, widening the range. Earnings on 11-17 fall inside this window.
tickers.ZETA: Since Sunday: little changed - price dipped slightly to 33.77 and the OPPOSING/NEUTRAL/OPPOSING/OPPOSING pattern across expiries held steady. Options are pricey throughout, and earnings on 11-03 add volatility risk to an already choppy setup.
tickers.AMAT: Since Sunday: little changed - price climbed 4.0% to 392.3, all expiries stay NEUTRAL, though ceilings rose (to 440 for 10-30, 392.5 for 11-06). Earnings land 11-12, inside this window, adding some event risk.
tickers.APP: No Sunday baseline. Price 259.16 is in a downtrend, with magnets near 280-300 and a ceiling around 270-280. Options are very pricey, especially around the 11-04 earnings date, meaning swings could be sharp.
tickers.SPY: Since Sunday: little changed - price rose 0.8% to 766.09, scores stay NEUTRAL, floors and ceilings barely moved. In VUSA terms the nearest magnet is about £108.85, floor £106.01, ceiling £113.84, a fairly contained range for a swing trade.
tickers.QQQ: Since Sunday: little changed - price gained 1.4% to 714.08, all NEUTRAL, though the 10-30 floor rose from 700 to 690. In rough ISUS terms the nearest magnet is about £80.83, floor £78.47, ceiling £83.86 (approximate, since ISUS only partly tracks the Nasdaq).
